title: 37 ## Other IPC Crimes 1.18.16 Cognizable IPC crimes which do not fall under any of the specified crimes discussed earlier are categorised as 'Other IPC crimes'. Since, this crime head forms a bulk of the total cases reported in the country, it will only be appropriate to highlight some of its general features. These crimes have gone up by 43.9 per cent over 1983 and by 8.0 per cent over the Q.A. (1988-92). However, a marginal decline of 0.4 per cent was noticed in the country in this year. As many as 10 States and 5 UTs in the country recorded higher rate than the national average of 102.2. These unspecified crimes generally push up the rank of criminality of States/UTs.
